text: Protocol v1 frozen before conditional coefficient inspection. Primary data are immutable GW-11 combined signal scores. Per-method adjusted model: bits ~ saliency_z * correct_ec + probe_type_ec. Primary uncertainty is 2,000-draw crossed participant-item bootstrap with shared draws; lmer crossed random intercepts are robustness only and singularity is reported. Three contrasts are saliency 20-to-100, correct-minus-incorrect at saliency 60, and their interaction per 20 points. Six GazeWeave engine contrasts receive Bonferroni familywise intervals plus 7-of-8 leave-one-participant sign stability. Probe/delay localization is descriptive and cannot rescue GW-11.
